item.tib: ma mo srog bsgrubs kyi brgyud las srung ba'i gur khang dbub pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang srid pa rgyal mo yis kho bo dbra khyung pa g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la dpal lung dung mtsho phyug mo'i 'gram du bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud cing / slar me rta zla tshes la dpal gyi gdan sa khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab pa'o/ sigs trigs srug
